title: ONE SIEGE SIZE: THE PROMISE MATCHES THE ARRIVALS
why: Found by the full test run of 2026-10-04: v18.06 cut the extraction siege to 5 + 7 x greed in the spawner only. The call still promised the old 6 + 8 x greed (about 10 machines with 8 coming), and the late pull wave and a linked window copy of the siege still counted the old size. One function holds the size now and all five places read it.
now: The extraction call now promises exactly as many machines as actually come.
